yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: Love the Lord with all.
days.teaching: Primary pursuit. Month focus — Heart Renovated — First Commandment: Return to first love. This week we carry "Sowing and Reaping" (Galatians 6:7). Physical Strength & Endurance flows from being loved first. Let Matthew 22:37 settle you: Love the Lord with all.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Strengthen this temple. Give me vitality and endurance to run my race to the crown.
days.declaration: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion.
days.decree: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion. Love the Lord with all. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Walk 10 minutes praying the declaration; honour rest and water today.

days.verse: You have forsaken your first love.
days.teaching: Remember, repent, return. Month focus — Heart Renovated — First Commandment: Return to first love. This week we carry "Sowing and Reaping" (Galatians 6:7). Deeper Love for All Humanity flows from being loved first. Let Revelation 2:4-5 settle you: You have forsaken your first love.

days.decree: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today. You have forsaken your first love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Do one deliberate kindness for someone unlovable or overlooked.

days.verse: Then your heart will become proud.
days.teaching: Comfort must not cool hunger. Month focus — Heart Renovated — First Commandment: Return to first love. This week we carry "Sowing and Reaping" (Galatians 6:7). Wisdom for the Abundant Life flows from being loved first. Let Deuteronomy 8:14 settle you: Then your heart will become proud.

days.action: Review one money choice; give or save as worship today.

days.verse: He restores my soul.
days.teaching: Still waters, restored soul. Month focus — Heart Renovated — First Commandment: Return to first love. This week we carry "Sowing and Reaping" (Galatians 6:7). Spiritual Warfare (Praying the Scriptures) flows from being loved first. Let Psalm 23:2-3 settle you: He restores my soul.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I put on the whole armour of God. No weapon formed against me shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17). I trample all the power of the enemy (Luke 10:19) and pull down every stronghold (2 Corinthians 10:4-5). Angels guard me in all my ways (Psalm 91:11).
days.declaration: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today.
days.decree: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today. He restores my soul. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Speak Ephesians 6:10-11 aloud; cancel one fear by name.

days.verse: Those who wait renew strength.
days.teaching: Waiting is working. Month focus — Heart Renovated — First Commandment: Return to first love. This week we carry "Faith in the Waiting" (Psalm 27:14). Sabbath Rest & Alignment flows from being loved first. Let Isaiah 40:31 settle you: Those who wait renew strength.
